literal: Than themselves / those who are greater / as one's own / conducting oneself / among strengths / all / the head.
translation: To conduct oneself by making those greater than oneself into one's own people is the foremost of all strengths.
modern: தன்னை விடச் சிறந்த பெரியவர்களைத் தன் சுற்றத்தாராகக் கொண்டு நடப்பது, ஒருவனுக்கு உள்ள வலிமைகள் எல்லாவற்றிலும் முதன்மையானதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the importance of surrounding oneself with wise and capable individuals. The phrase 'தம்மின் பெரியார்' refers to those who are greater in wisdom, virtue, or experience than oneself. 'தமரா ஒழுகுதல்' means treating them as one's own people or close allies and living in accordance with their guidance. The poet declares that securing such relationships is the foremost ('தலை') of all forms of strength, showing that true power comes from the support and counsel of great people.
